name: DevMatch
tagline: DevMatch — evidence-based engineer hiring for mission-driven teams.
description: DevMatch discovers cofounders and engineers who uniquely fit mission driven teams, matched on evidence of real work — open source contributions, writing, and talks — instead of resumes anyone can fake. Describe a role or paste a job description and get a unique-fit shortlist with public-work evidence and public contact channels. Three read-only tools: find_candidates, get_profile, and find_similar_projects.

env.name: DEVMATCH_API_KEY
env.description: API key from DevMatch. Without a key, calls can use x402 USDC.

install.notes: Remote streamable HTTP MCP at https://mcp.dev-match.xyz/mcp. Docs: https://dev-match.xyz/docs/mcp. Paste a job description into find_candidates to get a unique-fit shortlist with public-work evidence.
